# SiliconPath

SiliconPath is a semiconductor, VLSI & electronics opportunity aggregator for semiconductor and VLSI engineers.

## What we do
We aggregate JRF, PhD, government research jobs, and private sector opportunities in the semiconductor, VLSI & electronics industry. We update daily from official sources including DRDO, ISRO, CSIR, IITs, and international sources.

## Our data
- Opportunities feed: https://siliconpath.vercel.app/api/opportunities-feed
- Sitemap: https://siliconpath.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
- About: https://siliconpath.vercel.app/about
- Resources: https://siliconpath.vercel.app/resources

## Contact
For corrections or additions: admin@siliconpath.vercel.app

## Update frequency
Opportunities: Daily | News: Every 6 hours
